title: AR60009: District And Rural Area Planning
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Decentralized planning: conceptual framework; perspective plan, annual plan and
other terminologies; review of past plan experiences; need for district and
block planning under MLP framework; implications of 73rd and 74th amendment of
the constitution. Dimensions of District and Block planning: their spatial
disparities and sectoral variations; identification of spatial units under
decentralized planning; relevance of district sectors and blocks and their
identification; planning machinery and mechanism for decentralized planning;
administrative, operation and financial issues of decentralized planning. Data
and information for decentralized planning; sectoral planning issues and
policies; infrastructure planning; application of forecasting techniques;
social performance evaluation; resource mobilization and credit planning;
organizational aspects; participatory planning approach; training needs and
plan execution. Rural development schemes and programs, Plan financing,
monitoring and evaluation of rural development schemes.
